children: InnovAge entered into an underwriting agreement for a secondary offering of 10,000,000 shares at $9.25 per share.
Selling shareholder sold 10,000,000 firm shares to underwriters at $9.25 per share; InnovAge will not receive proceeds.
Underwriters — led by Barclays, Goldman Sachs and Wells Fargo — granted a 30-day option to buy up to 1,500,000 additional shares.
Offering registered on InnovAge’s Form S-3 (File No. 333-297888) with prospectus supplements dated September 22, 2026.
Shares were delivered against payment on September 24, 2026; underwriting agreement includes customary reps, covenants and indemnities.
